newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Beijing Orient to price B share IPO at HK$3.08.
newsitem.headline: Beijing Orient to price B share IPO at HK$3.08.

text.p: Beijing Orient Electronics (Group) Co Ltd will price its 100 million B share initial public offering in Shenzhen this week at HK$3.08 per share, a company official said on Monday.

The offer will carry a price/earnings ratio of 8.98 times, based on forecast 1997 net earnings per share of 0.3675 yuan on a fully diluted basis under international accounting standards, the official said. He declined to predict 1997 net profits.

The company, which produces lamps and television components, plans to use the proceeds to introduce a production line capable of making three million lamps annually, the official told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
Beijing Orient has named China Southern Securities as the lead domestic underwriter and Nomura International (HK) Ltd as the international consultant, he said.
The company posted net profits of 115 million yuan in 1996 against 100 million in 1995.
The firm currently has a total of 261.6 million shares -- excluding the new issue -- comprised of non-public founder and staff shares.
Beijing Orient is among 33 enterprises selected by the China Securities Regulatory Commission to list B shares.
